== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Listen to Star Trek CCG finalist Stephen Boyles RFD audio interview to hear all about his Star Trek CCG Dream Card." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
